Title: 3D Quality Check
Content: Permission: Admin, Collaborator, Editor Compatibility: Supported for 3D files. Find the detailed file format list here. Updates 3D Quality Check allows you to check the properties of the CLO file in CLO-SET. What it Quality Check? Setup Quality Check Quality Check in Content Page Quality Check Results Supported File Formats Setup Guide PDF (ENG) Details 1) What is 3D Quality Check? CLO-SET Quality check allows teams to automize the QC process of the CLO files. CLO-SET will automatically check the uploaded CLO file properties per the standards setup by the Admin and mark the result for the team to view. Quality Check standards can be set for each Company within the Group. 2) Setup Quality Check Permission: Group Admin, Company Admin To start using the feature, your Company must have a 3D Quality Check standards setup by the Admin. This can be done on the Company Settings page. In Company Settings, click Content &gt 3D Quality Check. Then, click the activate toggle. For more details on how to input the properties and what each property refers to in CLO, please download the PDF guideline. Please note: updating the properties will NOT be synced to older tests. You must re-upload the file to apply the new standards. 3) Quality Check in Content Page Permission: Admin, Collaborator, Editor Once the Quality Check is activated and setup, it will be applied to the newly uploaded files. Click the red 'QC' icon next to the version name to view the full test result. Please Note: Quality Check runs only once for all versions. Re-upload the file to run the quality check again. The 'QC' label will be displayed on the latest version uploaded. To review the QC for older versions, click the menu and select '3D Quality Check' option as displayed below. 4) Quality Check Results Permission: Admin, Collaborator, Editor A new tab will open with the full test result. Category of the property Property setup in Company Settings Criteria setup in Company Settings Test result: Passed Test result: Failed, click the list icon for the list of materials that failed the test Test result: N/A. Property not included in the checklist Select to only view the properties that failed the test Please note: Updating or editing the 3D file should be done in CLO. Also, Quality Check runs only once for all versions. Re-upload the file to run the quality check again. 5) Supported File Formats Compatible with all file types supported in 3D Viewer, as of Dec 2024. More specifically, 3D Quality Check is compatible with the file extensions listed below: zpac, zprj, avt, obj, fbx, dae, glb, grp, zfab, zmod, trm, btn, bth, zpl, zsd, zse, zsp, zpu, zsl, zst, zss, sst, zacs, pos, hpos

Title: 2D Pattern Viewer
Content: Permission: Admin, Collaborator, Editor, Viewer Compatibility: ZPRJ/ZPAC files uploaded from Dec 3rd, 2024. Please re-upload older files. Updates CLO-SET supports 2D Viewer for ZPRJ/ZPAC files. 2D Pattern Viewer (Default Display) Show/Hide Toolbar Mouse Navigation (Zoom/Panning) Annotation Details 1) 2D Pattern Viewer (Default Display) On the Content page, click the '2D' thumbnail button to begin. *Compatible with ZPRJ/ZPAC files uploaded from Dec 3rd, 2024. Please re-upload older files. By default, the 2D Viewer will match what is displayed in CLO3D software when the '2D &gt Point of Measure &gt Edit Point of Measure' option is turned off &amp Pattern Outlines unlocked. All information display fields are turned off by default. 2) Show/Hide Toolbar On the 2D Viewer, find the display toolbar to control the view Selective menus available at the moment. More to be released in near future. Garment Display (default: off) Show Baseline Information Display (default: all off) Show pattern name Show line length (displayed in mm only) Show angle Show grainline Show 2D measurements (displayed in mm only) Garment Rendering Style Front Textured Surface - Default Monochrome Surface For more details on each menu, visit the CLO3D article on 2D Window Display Icons 3) Mouse Navigation (Zoom/Panning) Zoom: Scroll up &amp down to zoom in &amp out Panning: 2 options available Wheel Click + Move Mouse Alt (Option) + Left Mouse Button + Move Mouse 4) Annotation on 2D Viewer You can create Annotations on the 2D Viewer to communicate with your team Thumbnail: Once Annotations are created, a blue label icon will be displayed on the Thumbnail &amp Version Annotation: Find the Annotations Annotation Tab: On the right pane of the screen, click on the Annotation button at the top to view the full list of Annotations created on the Content. Please note that the numbering will be shared between viewer types. That is, Annotations will be numbered in order of creation, regardless of the viewer type (3D or 2D).

Title: Visual Board
Content: Permission: Admin, Collaborator, Editor Objective Understand how to create/edit/share Visual Board in CLO-SET What is Visual Board? User Scenario Create Edit Mode Utilizing 3D Assets Edit Mode UI Invite &amp Share Export to PDF Permission &amp Notification Shortcut keys Details 1) What is Visual Board? Visual Board is a creation tool for showcasing your design using the 3D assets in CLO-SET. Users can now create Lookbooks or Moodboards with the 3D assets. Create Lookbook, Moodboard, or Presentation with your Assets Collaborate with your team online Drag &amp Drop 3D assets to add 2D Images with a click 2) User Scenario 3) Create Permission: Admin, Collaborator, Editor From your dashboard, click on 'Workspace' &gt 'Visual Board' Click '+' to create a new Visual Board Enter the title and description, then click 'Create' [Please Note] Only the creator of the Board &amp Group Admin will have access to the Board. Invite new members as Editors to the Board for collaboration. Editors of the Group will NOT be automatically added to the Board. 4) Edit Mode Permission: Group Admin, Board Creator, Board Editor (directly shared from Board's Share tab) Start editing the Board. You may use ALL assets you have access to within the Group. Please note: only 1 user can edit the Board at a time. While 1 user is editing, others can view Slide Show or Comments. Slide Show will be based on the last saved version. Make sure to click 'Save' once the work is complete. Click 'Share' to add Board Editors to grant edit access. Group members will NOT be automatically added. You must add the user as Editor to each Board for collaboration. [Important] When you add an external user (not a member of the Group) to the Board as Editor, additional charges will incur to your billing. Group Admin will receive notification. [Utilizing 3D Assets] To add your Contents/Files on the board, start dragging &amp dropping the Content from the right pane to the slide. When adding the Content, you have an option to embed a link to 3D viewer, Content Page, or Customer URL. Add Images: Select view(s) to add. Zprj/Zpac files: Select from Thumbnail, Front, Left, Right, and Back view. Other file types: Add Thumbnail image. Link (URL): Create hyperlink to the 3D Viewer, Content Page, or Custom URL to the image. Include Name: Insert the Content Name as a text object along with [Colorway Options] Select 'By Colorway' to add Images of different Colorways. By Content: displays Default Colorway (last selected when saved in CLO software). By Colorway: displays selected Colorway. Thumbnail: customizable on the original Content Page. [Edit Mode UI] Title: Title of the Board. Click to make changes. Save, Slide Show, Exit Save: save the current version Slide Show: preview and share slide show [Coming Soon] Export the Board Exit: leave edit mode. Changes will not be saved Share Edit Permission is unique for each Board. You must have Editor permission to the specific Board to make changes. Group Admin can access/edit/delete all Boards as a default. Creator of the Board automatically has Editor permission to the Board Add other members to the Board as Editors to collaborate. Group members will NOT be automatically granted permission to edit the Board. Adding a new Editor to the Board will include the invitee as a Group member. Slide List: add, duplicate, or delete each slide Edit Toolbar: add or edit components on/to your slide Edit Toolbar Bubble Toolbar Available Color Palettes please note: custom palettes uploaded as color preset are not yet supported in Visual Board Picker PANTONE coloro Slide Background / Undo &amp Redo Background: Select the background color of each slide Undo &amp Redo the edit action Search &amp Filter: find the Asset within the Group, or select the Space to find the Content. Asset List: Drag &amp Drop the Asset to the Board to add an Image. You can only use Assets you have permission to. Change Order: Select the object(s) and right click to change the order. Single Select: change the order of a single object. Bring to front: bring the object to the very front of the slide Bring forward: bring the object to move forward by 1 layer Send to back: bring the object to the very back of the slide (excluding background) Send backward: bring the object to move back by 1 layer Multi Select: change the order of multiple objects together. Order among the selected objects will remain. Bring to front: bring the objects selected the very front of the slide as a group Send to back: bring the objects selected to the very back of the slide as a group (excluding background) 4) Invite &amp Share (Slide Show Mode) Add Editor (Add Board Editor for collaboration) Click the 'Share' button at the top-right corner to add Board Editors Default: Only the Board Creator and Group Admin can edit. Add new Editors to each Board to grant Edit permission. [Important]: When you add an external user (not a member of the Group) to the Board as Editor, additional charges will incur to your billing. Group Admin will receive notification. Share &amp Publish (Share the slide show with external users) From Slide Show mode, click on the 'Share' button at the top-right corner Restricted: Only you and Can Edit member can access the slide show with link Publish: Anyone with link can view the slide show 6) Export to PDF On the Edit page, you can now export the Visual Board to a PDF. Selected Page: only export the selected page (single slide) All Pages: export the full Board (all slides) 7) Permission &amp Notification Permission to Visual Board Please note: Group members are NOT automatically granted access to all Boards. You must be added as an Editor to each Board to view/make changes to unpublished Boards. Notification Manage notifications regarding Visual Board on My Page Notification sent to: Group Admin, Board Creator, and Board Editors (anyone added to each Board with 'Can Edit' permission) 8) Shortcut Keys Key Details Ctrl/Command + z Ctrl/Command + y Undo Redo Ctrl/Command + a Select all objects Shift + h Shift + v Flip (horizontal) Flip (vertical) v i t b l p c Select Tool Image Tool Text Tool Pencil Tool Line Tool Curve Tool Shapes Tool [ Ctrl/Command + [ ] Ctrl/Command + ] Bring to front Bring forward Send to back Send backward

Title: Content Version Upload
Content: Objective You can upload a single file or turntable image as an uploaded version of a Content in Content page. Details Version Upload Thumbnail Change Version Rename Version Deletion 1) Version Upload 1. On the content page, click to upload newer versions. &gt2. Select the file format you wish to upload. Also, you may choose NOT to notify other collaborators on the new version upload. ('Do not notify collaborator'). 2) Thumbnail Change Select the file, and click 'Upload'. Once you upload the new version, CLO-SET will automatically update the content's thumbnail. If you wish to keep the original thumbnail from earlier versions, please turn on the 'Keep the current thumbnail' button. *The blue tab on your Version file indicates that there is Annotation on this content. *The 'Public' sign indicates that this content has been published to 'Embed Viewer' 3) Version Rename From the Content page, hover over the Version you'd like to rename. Click on , and then click 'Rename'. Type in the new Version name, and click 'Confirm'. *Please note that updating the Version name will NOT update the Content Name. Double-click on the Content Name to edit. 3.1) Where are Version Names used? Changing the Version name will auto-update the fields below. Downloaded file name Comment, Annotation, Attachment, Colorway tab WTP - Comment, Version update File name in CLO (if updated the latest Version) 4)Version Deletion 1. You may delete a single version of the content, keeping all other versions live. To delete a specific version, click the button next to it, and click 'Delete'. 2. Once you delete a specific version, it will not be shown under the Versions list. To view all versions including the deleted ones, click on 'View all histories' on the top right corner. 3. Please note that the deleted versions CANNOT be restored. Please be cautious when deleting a version with annotations, comments, or attachments.

Title: Supported File Formats in 3D Viewer
Content: Objective Learn about supported file formats in CLO-SET 3D Viewer. File Format Using 3D Viewer Details 1) File Format Type Format Description Garment *.zpac Contains information on garments, patterns, sewing, and fabrics. Project *.zprj Compressed version of multiple files used for garment creation. The Project file contains the AVT file that has avatar-related data (Avatar, Accessories, Arrangement Bounding Volumes, Arrangement Points, Avatar size, Poses), the ZPac file that contains garment-related data (3D Garments, 2D Patterns, Fabrics, subsidiary Material), as well as an animation file if there is any. Avatar *.avt, .avte Contains all the information related to Avatars (Model, Sizing data, Poses, Motions, Accessories, Bounding Volumes, Arrangement Points). OBJ *.obj Contains geometry and material information. Primarily used for importing avatar and related sources into the program. GL Transmission Format *gltf / glb Contains scene and material information using the JSON standard. Primarily used for importing avatar and related sources into the program. COLLADA *.dae This file can be exported from other 3D softwares such as 3ds Max, Maya, Pose, and DAZ Studio. These files contain geometry and material information, as well as rigging, skinning, and animation data When exporting COLLADA files from 3ds Max or Maya, install OpenCOLLADA plugin (http://www.opencollada.org/download.html) and export to use the avatar Fabric *.zfab Contains the property values (texture + physical properties) of the set fabric. Button *.btn Contains the type, size, and color of Buttons. Buttonhole *.bth Contains the type, size, and color of the Buttonholes. Trim *.trm Contains material information Zipper Puller *.zpl Contains the type, size, and color of Zipper Pullers. Zipper Slider *.zsd Contains the type, size, and color of Zipper Sliders. Zipper Stopper *.zsp Contains the type, size, and color of Zipper Stoppers. 2) Using 3D Viewer For more instructions on how to use CLO-SET 3D Viewer, click HERE.

Title: Virtual Showroom
Content: Start building your Virtual Showroom, in 360. Publish it online and start inviting your customers online. Permission: Admin, Collaborator, Editor Objective Find a detailed Virtual Showroom Setup Guide Checklist Virtual Showroom Setup Create Showroom Add/Edit Contents Virtual Showroom Live Download Preset Space Image Virtual Showroom Webinar Details 1. Checklist 1) Move Contents to Assortment. From Workroom, move Contents to Assortment From Assortment, create Virtual Showroom You can only add the 3D Contents located in the Assortment from which the Virtual Showroom is created. You can create 1 Virtual Showroom per Assortment 2) Prepare the Environment Image (Background of the Showroom) Take a 360 image or 2D Image of your physical Showroom. You may also choose to use CLO-SET preset images. 360 image file must be less than 8192 * 4096 px, 100mb. File formats can be png, jpg, webp, gif, or hdr. 2. Virtual Showroom Setup 1) Create Virtual Showroom On the Assortment page, click on Enter the name of your Virtual Showroom. Select Environment Type: Upload the 360 Space Image. You may also use the default preset image. Upload a 2D Image Upload your Logo, and click 'Create' *You can only create 1 Virtual Showroom per Assortment. If 2 or more users create simultaneously, the first version will be saved. 2) Add/Edit Contents 1 Add Space Image 2 Add Contents (3D, 2D, Navigation, and Other) 3 Content List 4 Settings - Name &amp Logo *You may only add space images of same type (360 or 2D) per your selection at the time of creation. 1 Add Space Image You may add multiple Space within your Showroom. Click 'ADD SPACE' on the top left, and upload the Space image to create additional Space Adding Navigation button will allow your users to switch between Spaces 2 Add Contents (Create Mark) Click '+' at the bottom to add a Content. Adding a Content will create a new Mark. For 3D Contents, drag &amp drop the one you want to add, and edit the name and Mark type. For 2D and Other Contents, upload the file you want to add. For Navigation, select the Mark type and select the Space to move to. Edit Mode on Live Showroom [Adding / Editing the Spot] 3D content Drag &amp Drop the Content to add a Spot on your Showroom Hover over the spot to view/edit the details Change the Name / Spot Color &amp Shape, and click 'Save' 3 Content List Click 'Content List' at the bottom to view all Contents loaded on your Showroom, and to edit or delete it. To remove the Content, hover over each Marker and click 'DELETE' 4 Settings - Name &amp Logo Add your logo image on Settings Turn on 'Share Live With Link' option to create a 'Share' button on your Live Showroom Edit Mode - Settings in Live Showroom 3) Virtual Showroom Live Once you're done setting up the Virtual Showroom, click on the to publish it. Once your Virtual Showroom is published, you may share the URL to your customers. Click to save any edits. This will not be reflected on your live Showroom. Click to test the Virtual Showroom before publishing it to live. You may view your 3D Contents in CLO-SET 3D Viewer after it's been published. 4)Download Preset Image You may download the preset 360 background image by following the link. https://drive.google.com/file/d/19ah3pr5RkbGthRiY3sdyWm2yDUh1eIYt/view?usp=sharing 5)Virtual Showroom Webinar Learn how to setup the Virtual Showroom in CLO-SET. Find a local language session on CLO-SET YouTube.

Title: Company Setting
Content: Permission: Group Admin, Company Admin Objective Company Admin can manage/set Companys space and customize fields within Company Setting. There are 9 tabs in Company Setting - we will break it down to 5 in terms of usage. General Category / Content - Workflow Content - Information Rendering Status / Customer Type / Sales Channel / Store Type Trash Details 1) General General tab is where you can manage basic profile info and operation of the Company. Change Company name Company Library - a unique Workroom where you can store commonly used Assets throughout the Company Line - an optional Space level between Brand and Season Content_Image Viewer - view Contents in flat 2D image as default, to fasten loading speed Accessible People - you may view the full list of users with access on each Space/Content Company Transfer - Transfer the Company from current Group to another Delete Company 2) Category / Content - Workflow Category and Workflow are customizable fields, used to identify/search/filter the Content. Category: can add custom Category up to 4th depth Workflow: can add custom Workflow stage, change name and color chips Utilizing Category &amp Workflow Identify the status of each Content Filter or Search the Content using Category &amp Workflow Quickly view the workflow status from Workroom 3) Content - Information The Content Field is where information about the Content is stored. Users can customize the fields used for each Content Type. Start storing Content information in CLO-SET to elevate your asset management flow. Content Fields are tailored for each Content Type. Fields used can only be managed by Company Admin and Group Operator. To start adding custom fields, read the instructions below. Before inputting information on the Content, we recommend that you review the fields used for each Content Type. To add/edit Content Fields for each Content Type, visit Company Settings. Click on 'Content' &gt 'Information' to view the list of Content Types and Fields used. Content Fields are shared and applied to all Contents within the Company. 1. Default Fields Default Fields can NOT be added or deleted. You can change the name, values, and unit format. CLO-SET Provides tailored Defaults Fields for each Content Type. For example, for Style type Contents, there are 6 Default Fields - material composition, customer type, color, price, MOQ, and date. To edit the name, value, or unit format, click the pencil icon at the end of the table. On the Edit modal, edit the details and click 'Save'. 2. Custom Fields Custom Fields are fully customizable. Can create up to 16 Custom Fields per Content Type. To add a Custom Field, start by clicking the 'Add Custom Field' button. Fill in the name and select the 'Type' of the field to be used. Fill in values or unit information when applicable, and click 'Save' to create the Custom Field. Field Types provided are listed below. Once the field is saved, field type CANNOT be changed. Text (up to 100 characters) Textbox (up to 1000 characters) Number (in unit format) Date (in calendar format) Dropdown: single-selection Checkbox: multi-selection allowed To edit the Custom Field, click the pencil icon at the end of the table. Changing the field details will impact the existing field information. To delete the Custom Field, hover over the field row and click the trash button. Deleting the field will impact the existing field information, and the data stored will no longer be available. 3. 'Number' Type Fields Unit Options Currency Options for Price Unit Format Example When editing the 'Number' type fields, you have an option to customize the unit format. Please refer to the table below for placeholders used to customize the unit format. Placeholder Explanation 0 The number of digits. Insignificant zeros are displayed in the result # The number of digits. Meaningless zeros will not appear in the result . (decimal point) Format numbers with decimal separators , (rest) Specifies a thousands separator in a number 4) Rendering Add a Render Preset to share throughout the Company as a guideline. In Company Settings, you can Add/Change/Delete the Preset file (ZVRP) for your Company. Click on the link to find out more. 5) Status / Customer Type / Sales Channel / Store Type Customizable Fields are available for use on Line Sheet - List Mode to detail each Colorway. Add new fields for your Company, and start utilizing them on Line Sheet. Status: Add custom fields to identify the status for each Colorway Workflow can be set on Content level, and Status can be changed per Colorway on Line Sheet Customer Type / Sales Channel / Store Type: Add custom fields to use on Line Sheet 6) Trash Deleted Contents/Workroom/Brand is stored for 30 days on the Trash tab. Company Admin may restore the files by selecting them and clicking on RESTORE button.

Title: Video Viewer
Content: Objective Play video files directly on the CLO-SET Viewer and upload video clips as attachment. Requirements How to Details 1) Requirements Compatible File Format: MP4, MKV, MOV, AVI, FLV, MPEG-2 TS, MPEG-2 PS, MXF, LXF, GXF, 3GP, WebM, MPG, and QuickTime. Maximum file size up to 200MB. 2) How to Upload a Video file in your Workroom On the Content page, click on the 'Play' button () to start playing the clip Clicking on the viewer again will pause the clip. Manage volume and settings the bottom. Viewer Selector Thumbnail: First frame of the uploaded video file Content Info Thumbnail: Expand the Content Info tab to change the Thumbnail to be displayed on Workroom View Video Viewer Settings Play/Pause Volume Quality Speed Picture-in-picture mode Full Screen Attachment: Attach a video file to the uploaded Content. Same requirements apply for file compatibility.

Title: Render Preset
Content: Render Preset option allows you to provide a uniform Render Setting as a guideline throughout the Company. Permission (Add/Change/Delete): Company Admin Permission (Use): Admin, Collaborator, Editor *See below for permission details Objective Save as ZVRP from CLO3D Add/Change/Delete Render Preset Using Render Preset Render Preset - Properties Details 1) Save as ZVRP from CLO3D To start using the new Render Preset feature in CLO-SET, you will need a ZVRP file. On CLO3D software, change Render settings you'd like to save using Property Editor (Image/Video, Light, and Render) Once you are done, click Save As &gt Render Properties to save as ZVRP file. The saved ZVRP includes Image/Video, Camera, Light, and Render properties. Scroll down to #4 for the detailed list of properties to be reflected on CLO-SET Render. A few requirements for CLO-SET: Image count for Turntable must be less than 64 Image size must be less than 5,000px Animation type can not be rendered *Please note: If you select the 'Current View' option from CLO3D, CLO-SET Render will be based on the last view each user sees on their CLO-SET 3D Viewer. 2)Add/Change/Delete Render Preset Company Admin ONLY - Managing the Render Preset for each Company can only be done by the Company Admin. If you are a Collaborator or below, please contact your Admin for support. Click on your Company &gt 'Settings' &gt 'Rendering' to Add/Edit/Delete Render Preset. Click on 'Upload File' to add a Render Preset. You may add up to 32 files. Click on 'Change File' to upload a new ZVRP file. This will NOT affect the previous Render output. The new setting will be used for future Render works. Click 'Download' to save the ZVRP file. Click on the 𝒊 icon to view the property details. Click on X to delete the Render Preset. 3) Using Render Preset Editors or above can utilize the Render Preset for each Content. On your Content Page, click on Render to select the Render Settings. On the drop-down menu, you will see the Company Preset (with icon) Users may save a Preset for themselves. In this case, the individual user's Preset will be shown at the bottom of the drop-down menu. Once you select the Company's Render Preset option, you can not change the Render Settings. You may check the Property details by clicking on the 𝒊 icon. 4) Render Preset - Properties Please find the full list of Render Property to be reflected on CLO-SET Render. Image/Video Property Image Type (image/ turntable) Colorway View Point Image Format Image Size Unit (px/in/mm/cm) Resolution Color Texture Crop For Turntable Image Image Count Rotation Angle Rotation Axis Direction Save Video Save GIF Total Duration Frame Duration Video Format Light Property Preset Rectangle Light Sphere Light Directional Light Spot Light IES Light Dome Light Render Property Noise Threshold Seam Puckering Intensity Light Material Linear Workflow Color Mapping Type Burn Value A few requirements for CLO-SET: Image count for Turntable must be less than 64 Image size must be less than 5,000px Animation type can not be rendered *Please note: If you select the 'Current View' option from CLO3D, CLO-SET Render will be based on the last view each user sees on their CLO-SET 3D Viewer.

Title: Render
Content: Objective You can render the images on the 3D Viewer in the content page. Check real-time rendering progress and download the rendered file by clicking icon on the Content page. Update in Render Settings (Feb 2024) Render - How To Crop Option in Render Setting Rendering Server Status Render Preset Render in CLO vs CLO-SET Details Update in Render Settings (Feb 2024) The default background setting has been updated to match your Render Settings in CLO3D. You may choose to disable the option to customize the Render background in CLO-SET. 1) Render - How To 1. Click (Render) icon on the left pane of the Content page. 2. It will lead you to 'Rendering Settings' where you can set the Colorway, Type, Image Size, Background, and Quality of rendered images. 3. After the setting, click 'Render' button to start rendering. *Please note that the maximum image size is 5000px. *For Turntable images, maximum image count on CLO-SET is 64. 2) Crop Option in Rendering Setting crops to the nearest 5 pixels of the 3D content, regardless of what is shown in the 3D Viewer works both in transparent and colored background Style Page &gt Render &gt Rendering Settings &gt Background &gt Crop You must uncheck the 'Use Software settings' before applying the Crop option In order to properly use the 'Crop' option, the 3D content needs to be placed within the darkened frame shown inside the 3D Viewer. Although the darkened frame does not reflect the cropped frame when the Crop option in clicked, the 3D content is first cropped by the darkened frame. Thus, if the 3D Content sits outside of the darkened frame, the render will be cropped. For example, if the render is triggered as shown below on the left, the result will be as the following on the right. Final Render output shown below. 3) Rendering Server Status 'CLO-SET Rendering Server Status' is a feature that allows users to be more aware of their rendering status with the information of server status and their current orders in the rendering queues. Find out more details on THIS ARTICLE. 4) Render Preset For a unified Render output, you may upload a Render Preset for your Company members. Find out more here. 5) Render in CLO vs CLO-SET Basically, V-Ray's CPU and GPU rendering don't produce identical results. CLO and CLO-SET both use Vray Rendering. However, CLO-SET only supports GPU rendering, whereas CLO supports both GPU and CPU rendering. The results of the GPU render of CLO and the render of CLO-SET are consistent. But, as CPU and GPU rendering results differ, you cannot expect to see the same results between the CLO CPU and CLO-SET GPU rendering results. We suggest the following workflow. Select the device before starting the rendering task and generate the final output. Choose either one of the workflow. Utilizing GPU rendering in CLO and CLO-SET.Utilizing CPU rendering in CLO. Unfortunately, attempting to synchronize the CPU and GPU is impossible.

Title: Group
Content: Objective Understand the CLO-SET Group structure. Understanding the Group structure and operation is an initial step in collaborating with your team using CLO-SET. What is a 'Group'? Pricing Plan Group Hierarchy Permission Company Transfer Leave a Group Details 1) What is a Group? When a new user signs up in CLO-SET, a new Group is created. Group is the highest level Space in CLO-SET, and within each Group are Spaces such as Company - Brnad - Line - Season etc. You may invite other teammates to your Group, or be invited to another user's Group for collaboration. CLO-SET operates on a Group level. That is, Structure, Permission, and Pricing Plan is determined per Group. 2) Pricing Plan CLO-SET Pricing Plan is applied to each Group. You may check which Plan the Group is using on your dashboard. Please check out our Pricing Page to learn about different options. 3) Group Hierarchy CLO-SET Group consists of different Spaces in a hierarchy. Within each Group can be multiple Company, Brand, Line, Season, Workroom, and Assortment Spaces. You may invite or share each Space with your teammates. Learn more about creating Spaces here. 4) Permission CLO-SET has a total of 5 Permission levels to provide for advanced security control options on your assets. Please check out this article to see different types of Permissions. Permission is also applicable to each Group. For example, you may be a Company Admin within 1 Group, but a Viewer on another Group. 5) Company Transfer Permission: Group Admin / Company Admin Company Transfer allows users to transfer Company between different Groups. This can be an alternative option when your Group Admin changed and you need to change the Group Admin to a different account. 1. Go to 'Company Setting'. 2. Click 'Company Transfer' and enter the Admin email of the recipient Group. 3. Admin of the recipient Group must accept the request to complete the transfer. Log in to CLO-SET to accept. Please be noted that the RECIPIENT of the Company must be on Advanced Plan. 6) Leave a Group Permission: Company Admin / Collaborator / Editor / Viewer / Group Operator Members of the Group can choose to leave a Group without further actions from Admin. Select the Group from the drop-down menu at the top left corner. Go to 'Workspace' or 'Console' tab on the left. (Menu options may differ based on your permission) Click 'Leave This Group' at the bottom. Confirm the action by clicking 'OK'. Make sure to check the name of the Group you are leaving. Upon leaving the Group, Group Admin and Group Operator will receive notifications. *Group Admin cannot leave the Group. *Once you click 'OK', you may NOT undo the action. Please reach out to Group Admin to regain access.

Title: Plan Restrictions (Measurement Standard)
Content: Objective Understand plan limits and how the usage fields are calculated in CLO-SET. Your Group may have limited availability on selective features. Check CLO-SET Pricing Page for more details. User Company &amp Workroom File Upload Rendering Embed View CLO-SET API Usage History Plan Limit Error &amp Upgrade Details Based on your Group's usage, you may need to upgrade your plan or pay additional charges. Visit CLO-SET Pricing page to find the full list of plan types and feature availability. 1) User Free Plan: invite/share with up to 3 users Standard/Premium Plan: invite/share unlimited number of users. Charges apply per the number of users in the Group. Users with Admin, Collaborator, Editor, or Viewer permission to any Space within the Group will be counted towards billing. Group Operators are not included. Review the full list of users in the Group on Console - Settings - Permission Management. If CLO employees are invited to your Group for support, they are excluded from the user count. 2) Company &amp Workroom Free Plan: create up to 1 Company and 1 Workroom Standard Plan: create up to 1 Company and 10 Workrooms Premium Plan: unlimited Space creation All Companies and Workrooms within the Group are counted, even if there is no Content uploaded within the Space. On CLO-SET dashboard, click 'Workspace' button from the left pane. Click 'All Companies' or 'All Workrooms' to view the full list, and make changes if needed. 3) File Upload Free Plan: up to 10 files uploads per month. Renewed on the 1st of each month. Standard/Premium Plan: unlimited file uploads and storage. All file uploads, including version uploads and deleted files, are counted. 'Sample.zprj' file created as a default is excluded from the count. Visit Console - Billing - Usage History to review the file upload usage for each measurement period. 4) Rendering Rendering usage is based on the Render output file size. For Rendering details, visit 'Workspace - Rendering' or 'Console - Billing - Usage History' Free Plan up to 300MB per month. Limit resets on the 1st of each month. You must upgrade your plan to use more Rendering. Premium &amp Standard Plan up to 3 GB (Premium) or 1 GB (Standard) per user in the Group each month. Limit resets on the subscription renewal date. Additional charges apply for usage exceeding the limit. $10 per 1 GB will be billed on the groups next payment. When you add a user to the group during your subscription, well adjust the usage based on the remaining days and provide a proportional amount. 5) Embed Viewer The Embed Viewer count is based on the number of times end users open the Embed Viewer created from the content within your group. This includes all direct visits via the URL/QR code and access through the 3D Viewer URL embedded in your Visual Board. Visit 'Console - Billing - Usage History' to view the current status. Add-on purchase option is not available for Embed Viewer usage. Please upgrade or add users to the Group to allow more view counts. Free Plan up to 30 views per month. Limit resets on the 1st of each month. You must upgrade for additional usage. Standard Plan up to 100 views per user in the Group each month. Limit resets on the subscription renewal date. You must upgrade for additional usage. Premium Plan up to 300 views per user in the Group each month. 6) CLO-SET API CLO-SET API is available under the Premium plan or Enterprise plan only. All API calls made for your Group will be counted, except the oAuth option. Premium Plan up to 300 API Calls per user in the Group each month. Limit resets on the subscription renewal date. Additional charges apply for usage exceeding the limit. $5 per 300 calls will be billed on the groups next payment. 7) Usage History To review your Group's feature usage, please visit Console - Billing - Usage History. 8) Plan Limit Error &amp Upgrade If your group exceeds the plan limit, you'll see an error message prompting an upgrade. Group Admin &amp Group Operators Visit Console &gt Summary and click 'Change Plan' to upgrade the plan All other permission You will not be able to upgrade the Group's plan. Please contact your Group Admin.

Title: New Configurator
Content: Permission: Admin, Collaborator, Editor Objective Learn how to use the New Configurator in CLO-SET Requirements Configurator UI Color Color Switch Basic Parameters Auto-generate Normal Map Reflection Save/Add Colorway Troubleshooting Details Learn about the New Configurator from the CLO-SET Team! 1) Requirements Compatibility: Zprj/Zpac files saved on CLO 2024.1.244 or above 2) Configurator UI Configurator Tab On the new Content Page, select the 'Configurator' tab to use the tools. Object Browser View the list of objects used on the garment. Select an object to edit. Colorway List List of Colorways (from original file &amp created via CLO-SET Configurator) Tool Bar Switch between 'Select' and 'Edit Texture' tool Select object to be edited Edit Texture to zoom in/out or move the applied texture with a Gizmo tool. *Using the 'Edit Texture' will edit all 6 maps in Basic Parameters and Reflection. To edit each parameters separately, please use the Basic Parameters tab to input specific values. Property Editor Edit material property including Color, Basic Parameters, and Reflection. Save/Add Colorway 'Save': edits made will be saved to the current selected Colorway. Only available for Configurator-created Colorways. 'Add': edits made will be saved as a new Colorway *Please Note: New Colorways created with New Configurator are NOT editable on the conventional Configurator. 3) Color 1. To start, select an object from your garment () 2. Click on 'Color' tab to start editing. 3. Choose the color to be applied to the selected pattern Picker PANTONE coloro Picker: select the color to apply from the color picker, and click 'Find' below to find similar PANTONE color chips. Users may select from HEX/RGB/HSL options to input the color code. PANTONE: select a color chip to be applied. Use the drop-down list for PANTONE palettes. coloro: select a color chip to be applied. Search using the color name Custom: select a color chip from your custom palette 4. Use the '&lt (Back)' button to edit other material properties, or click 'Reset' to reset the properties. *Please note the the 'Reset' option will reset all properties including Color, Texture, and Reflection. [Color Switch] Color Switch prepares the solid fabric for a smooth transition to the newly selected color, ensuring it is applied accurately and seamlessly. Learn about the Color Switch feature in CLO 2024.2 How To: Open the New Configurator, and select an object to start From the right pane, click 'Base Color Map' tab Below the Base Color Map, you will find the 'Color Switch' option Please note that you can ONLY use either Desaturation or Color Switch, not both. When one is turned off, the other can be activated Once the 'Color Switch' is turned on explore new colorways by changing the Color or Opacity Color Switch and Desaturation can be used for all types of objects, except for button hole. 4) Basic Parameters 1. To start, select an object from your garment () 2. Click on 'Basic Parameters' tab to start editing. 3. Choose the maps to be applied to the selected pattern Texture Normal Map Displacement Map Opacity Map Basic Parameters works the same as in CLO's Property Editor. Learn more HERE. Select the parameter to edit Upload, delete, or download a new map to be applied Type in specific number fields to adjust the parameters in detail *Opacity can be applied without the Opacity Map, and will be applied to the whole fabric. To apply opacity to selective parts of the fabric, please upload an opacity map. 4. Use the '&lt (Back)' button to edit other material properties, or click 'Reset' to reset the properties. *Please note the the 'Reset' option will reset all properties including Color, Texture, and Reflection. [Auto-generate Normal Map] CLO-SET will auto-generate a Normal Map based on the Base Color Map for objects that have only the Base Color Map applied and no Normal Map available. Conditions: Normal Map will be generated ONLY when the selected object meets ALL of below has Base Color Map does NOT have normal map user adjusts Normal Map Intensity to a non-zero value Deleting the base color map of the object will also delete the normal map. The auto-generated normal maps will be deactivated when the Intensity is set back to 0. 5) Reflection 1. To start, select an object from your garment () 2. Click on 'Reflection' tab to start editing 3. Adjust the Reflection. Reflection works the same as in CLO's Property Editor. Learn more HERE. Reflection has 2 properties - Roughness and Metalness Roughness can be edited in 2 modes - Intensity &amp Roughness Map Intensity: Edit fabric gloss by adjusting Intensity of the Roughness Roughness Map: Edit fabric gloss by adding/modifying Roughness Map Metalness can be applied without the Metalness Map, and will be applied to the whole fabric. To apply metalness to selective parts of the fabric, please upload a Metalness map. 6) Save/Add Colorway When editing is complete, click 'Add Colorway' to create a new Configurator-created Colorway. All new Colorways created in CLO-SET will have the purple water drop icon on the Thumbnail. Users cannot overwrite the Colorways from original file. Edits made can only be saved as a new Colorway (with purple water drop icon). Configurator-created Colorways (with purple water drop icon) can be edited/saved on CLO-SET. *Please Note: New Colorways created with New Configurator are NOT editable on the conventional Configurator. 7) Troubleshooting Compatibility: to use Configurator, please use a desktop or laptop. Any monitors with resolutions below 800 cannot use Configurator Per the object type, there may be limitations to which parameters can be adjusted. Such restrictions will be disabled per the user's object selection. For example, you can only edit the Color of Graphic. Basic Parameters and Reflection will be disabled.

Title: Web Tech Pack ▶ BOM
Content: Permission: Admin Collaborator Editor Objective CLO-SET Web Tech Pack integrates your everyday tech pack with 3D Contents. Let us bring all the data from your 3D file into an auto-generated Tech Pack. Enjoy a tech pack that is always up-to-date. On the BOM tab, you can add/edit subsidiary materials and estimated cost critical for production. Colorway/Grade/Version Edit Material Detail Add Material Item Add/Delete Row Version Update Details 1)Colorway/Grade/Version You may view the BOM data per Colorway, Grade, and Content Version Colorway - You may create new Colorway from CLO/MD software Grade - You may create new Grades in CLO3D software Version - When you upload a new version of the Content on CLO-SET, you can choose to update WTP information accordingly. [Important] Information is managed and updated per Colorway-Grade combination, for all files uploaded from November 5th, 2024. For other files uploaded prior to this date, please re-upload. 2) Edit Material Detail Non-Editable: Content ID (if uploaded on CLO-SET) / Name / Color / Texture / Marker are extracted from your zprj/zpac file. Editable: Consumption / Unit Price / Total Price / Remark can be edited on WTP. This information will also be reflected on WTP - Cost Estimation tab Material information may be added/edited/deleted per Colorway/Grading/Version per your selection. 3) Add Material Item If needed, add Fabric and Trim materials by clicking the + button on your right. Contents added directly from CLO-SET will be marked with a blue 'CLO-SET' icon next to the 'Name' as shown below. Please note that the Content Type must match the type of material you want to add. For example, to add a material under Fabric, the uploaded file must be in zfab format and identified as Fabric Content Type in CLO-SET. User must have 'Editor' or above permission to the Workroom to which the original Content (to be added as Material) is saved. When adding a material from CLO-SET, it will load the latest version that matches the file format. Version updates on the Trim files will NOT be reflected to the WTP automatically. If needed, please delete the old material and add it again. If the Trim file is deleted in CLO-SET, the BOM table will mark the material as 'deleted'. *Content Type can be selected upon upload. You can not change/edit the Type after the upload. WTP Section / Subsection Content Type File Format Fabric Fabric zfab Trim / Graphic Graphic jpg, jpeg, gif, png, bmp, raw, psd, ai, tif, tiff, svg Trim / Button Head Button Head btn Trim / Button Hole Button Hole bth Trim / Zipper Zipper zpl, zpu, zsd, zsl, zst, zss, zsp Trim / Thread Top Stitch / Thread sst Trim / Top Stitch Top Stitch / Thread sst Trim / Others Etc trm 4) Add/Delete Row You may delete/add rows on the BOM table. Right-click on the Row to either delete it or add new above/below the selected row. 5) WTP Version Update When you upload a new version of the Style Content, you have an option to update the WTP If you upload a file format other than .zprj/.zpac as a new version to a Style Content Type, New WTP information will be reflected on BOM / Construction / Measurement / Cost Estimation. Once you click 'UPDATE', the Style information in Web Tech Pack will be updated. If you accidentally press the 'CANCEL' button, you must re-upload the same file. Cancelling cannot be undone. What does an 'update' mean in Web Tech Pack? If new materials were added to the project file, the new materials will be added to the BOM If the existing materials have been updated from the software, the updates will be reflected to the new version of the Web Tech Pack If you have deleted any material on the previous versions of the Web Tech Pack, the new version will EXCLUDE the deleted materials, even if it is included on the new project file uploaded. Version updates on the Trim files registered on the BOM is NOT reflected automatically Editing the Web Tech Pack information manually can only be done on the latest WTP version Once you update the Web Tech Pack version, deleting the new version file from the Content Page will NOT delete the corresponding WTP version. You will be able to review the data, but the WTP will be marked as 'deleted'.

Title: Line Sheet - List Mode

Title: 3D Tech pack
Content: Objective 3D Techpack is the function to check Tech pack in 3D Viewer by clicking the icon . Users can directly check the tech pack in 3D Viewer. How-to Tech Pack Document Web Tech Pack Excel Tech Pack Details 1) How-to 1. Move Widget: Users can move the position of the widget. 2. Material Placement: Users can check the placement of each category of PATTERN, FABRIC, and TRIM. 3. Material Layout: Users can check the layout of each category of PATTERN, FABRIC, and TRIM. 2) Tech Pack Document CLO-SET provides auto-generated Tech Pack to bring the 3D data all the way to production.
